note: Units whose values do not divide into a meaningful 'N times' (the owner, 2026-11-13: a quantity such as life expectancy, where dividing one place's value by another's means nothing, gets no 'N 倍' sentence). Years (life expectancy, years of schooling), scores and scales, indices to a base year, and percentage changes or growth rates. Built from unit-short-zh.tsv rules index_base, score and pct_change and wb-units.tsv rules years_life, years, name_score, scale, annual_growth, index_2015 and index_2010. A level page in one of these units says its highest place with no ratio (shape_registry LEVEL_PLAIN_HEADLINE) and its bracket prints no ratio; nothing else changes.
